actual_scope: Test exactly one new arity-four bundle Q_S: z += sum_{j in S} B_j x_j, charged as four B-map additions and one root transition, on the minimal restored all-mask six-source paired-readout connector profile. Search all 756,000 words with one Q4 and ten singleton calls; use a complete five-source screen only as the evidence-driven pivot record. Derive the cost obstruction for every other parity-allowed source-call count in the same one-Q4 alphabet.
scope_change_reason: The generic one-operation card is refined to the unused arity-four source bundle. The exact five-source minimal profile has no cover (maximum 25/31); this evidence motivated the single pivot to n=6, the first domain with enough boundary pairs for 63 masks.
bottleneck_link: A universal connector word determines how many expensive recursive source and output calls are needed. An arity-four bundle could reduce root transitions only if its boundary differences still realize every output mask; this local interface result does not itself admit a selected multiplication supplier or change kappa.
stop_rule: Exhaust the 15,120-word five-source pivot and 756,000-word six-source minimal profile; derive pair-readout lower bounds for the shorter and longer parity-allowed profiles. Stop after this one Q4 family; do not expand to other arities or source counts this cycle.
evidence: Exact normalized enumeration: n=5 has 15,120 orders, zero full covers, maximum 25/31; n=6 has 756,000 orders, zero full covers, maximum 41/63. For n=6, the 9-source-call case has at most 45 pair masks and needs at least 162 output calls; the 11-call census leaves at least 22 masks unpairable, needing at least 170 output calls. Any next source length is at least 13 calls and 16 B additions, hence at least (139,142) in the uniform (o,p) model, componentwise worse than the PR2146 TRIO profile (138,140). Positive and negative controls, exact pins and deterministic result are in this package.
